title: Danubius Hotel Gellért Budapest: Art Nouveau Hotel Guide
description: Budapest's Art Nouveau Hotel Gellért, linked to Red Sparrow, I Spy and Mephisto, opened in 1918 beside famous thermal baths.
h1: Hotel Gellért: Budapest's Art Nouveau landmark from Red Sparrow
intro: At the foot of Gellért Hill, beside the Danube, the Hotel Gellért is the grand Art Nouveau hotel of Budapest. Its Secessionist halls have been popular with film crews.
filming: Listings connect the hotel to the spy thriller Red Sparrow (2018), the comedy I Spy (2002) and the Oscar-winning drama Mephisto (1981). Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton famously stayed at the Gellért while filming in Budapest.
facts: The hotel opened on 26 September 1918, as the first luxury hotel in Budapest.
It was designed by Ármin Hegedűs, Artúr Sebestyén and Izidor Sterk.
Early features included in-room telephones and piped thermal water.
The hotel suffered significant damage in the siege of Budapest in 1945.
The Gellért Baths next door have been closed since October 2025 for refurbishment, with a planned reopening in 2028.
visit: Check the baths' status before you book, as they are closed for renovation. The hotel is a short tram ride from the city centre.
